messages:
ryan-cs: paging - customers reporting embeddings endpoint returning long chat-like text instead of vectors, started ~09:20 UTC. customers: partner-alpha, retail-ops, devtools-inc. apps are failing on vector insert with serialization errors. stack traces attached by support.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-2026-042 - embeddings->chat outputs on embed route. Paging on-call: @eli-oncall.
eli-oncall: on it, joining. can someone drop a sample request/response? need headers + model alias used.
ryan-cs: sample request (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Model: alias:customer-aware-embed-v2
Input: "product feature list"
```
response body (truncated):
```
{"id":"resp_123","object":"text_completion","choices":[{"text":"Hey! here's a summary..."}],"usage":{}} 
```
this clearly looks like a chat/gen payload not an embedding vector. :confused:
maya-eng-runtime: ack. looking at router logs now. quick grep shows alias customer-aware-embed-v2 resolves to variant conv-chat-v3 in eu-west-1 repeatedly since 09:10 UTC.
maya-eng-runtime: found config change in routing-service at 09:08 UTC: alias-sync job applied a mapping that tied alias -> variant by anchor id rather than by capability. PR id: infra/3489. snippet:
```
alias_mapping["customer-aware-embed-v2"] = resolved_anchor.variant
```
should have used capability-aware resolver.
eli-oncall: that would explain it — fallback logic picked a compatible anchor but not a compatible variant. paging eng-runtime @maya-eng-runtime and oncall-ops @tom-sre.
tom-sre: I'm on pager. checking fallback policy rules now. if we can short-circuit alias to the pinned embedding variant we can stop bad routing.
maya-eng-runtime: current quick mitigation: flip alias back to last-known-good variant id (variant-id: embed-v2-2025-11) via routing-service admin API. Preparing command.
eli-oncall: please patch in readonly mode first and confirm by dry-run.
maya-eng-runtime: running dry-run:
```
POST /admin/alias/resolve?dry_run=true
{"alias":"customer-aware-embed-v2","force_variant":"embed-v2-2025-11"}
```
result: would route 98% of current embed traffic to embed-v2-2025-11, 2% remain on conv-chat-v3 due to sticky sessions in eu-west-1. proceeding to commit.
maya-eng-runtime: committed change at 09:26 UTC. alias now pinned to embed-v2-2025-11. router cache invalidation pushed to edge nodes.
ryan-cs: customer-impact: partner-alpha reports ~8k failed inserts, retail-ops saw UI errors for ~12 minutes, devtools-inc retries caused increased rate-limits. ETA from customers: some automated retries already spammed downstream pipelines.
lisa-support: opened cases with affected customers, added mitigation steps and asked them to restart ingestion workers. CS updated SLA notes.
jess-product: any downstream side-effects from pinning? will A/B rollout be affected?
maya-eng-runtime: embed-v2-2025-11 is slightly older but same API surface. latency ~+5ms, no schema change. safe for immediate pin.
tom-sre: monitoring shows error rate for embeddings endpoint dropping to baseline within 2 minutes post-change. some residual gen-style responses still trickling due to cached connections - Nginx keepalives. recommending connection drains for edge nodes.
eli-oncall: initiating edge drain and service restart on affected node pool in eu-west-1. ETA 5m.
incident-bot: edge-drain job started by eli-oncall at 09:34 UTC.
ryan-cs: customers confirmed partial recovery; partner-alpha still reports ~120 failures - will follow up.
maya-eng-runtime: root cause preliminary: alias-sync job changed resolution semantics in infra/3489 to prefer anchor affinity over capability. regression slipped through canary because canary traffic didn't include embed-only aliases.
jess-product: action items: (1) revert alias-sync change and rework resolver to be capability-aware, (2) add unit/integration test for embed/chat capability gating, (3) add canary test that hits embeddings endpoints with embed-only aliases. owners: maya-eng-runtime + infra.
eli-oncall: documenting timeline and impact for postmortem. estimated customer-impact: 3 customers, ~20k failed requests across a 15m window, two enterprise customers affected; estimated SLO blip: 0.6% token-level degradation for embeddings during interval. assigning postmortem lead: maya-eng-runtime.
ryan-cs: liaison to customers: ryan-cs will coordinate credits and incident summaries.
maya-eng-runtime: we should also add a routing-policy guard: if endpoint==/v1/embeddings and resolved_variant.capabilities does not include "embeddings", reject with 409 and fall back to next compatible variant or fail fast. filing ticket.
eli-oncall: agree. temporary mitigation: block conv-chat variants on embed routes at edge ACL level while we fix resolver.
maya-eng-runtime: ACL rule applied at 09:46 UTC for eu-west-1 edges.
lisa-support: customers notified that mitigation applied and to expect full recovery within 15-30m. provided workaround: rotate client connections.
ryan-cs: marking incident as mitigated but still investigating. will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident status -> Mitigated by eli-oncall, reassigned to Postmortem queue."
